summary: Read one positive integer n. Its value is at least 1 and at most 10^5. Split n into separate decimal digits. Multiply those digits together, add those same digits together, and subtract the sum from the product. Write the resulting difference. When n has only one digit, the product and the sum are both that digit, so the written difference is 0. Use only the decimal digits of n and leave out any sign or separator.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
